title: A handoff points at a list's home instead of copying the list
why: shiv, Oct 30 12:55 CDT: Triage 12's handoff carried a hand-copied list of open waiting-page items; after a compaction it still named two closed items (82, 86). Its check-in prompt carried the same copy. Any copy of state that has a home (waiting page, roadmap, git) goes stale at the next change. hooks/precompact_handoff_prompt.md has no line against it (read Oct 30).
note: Fix: one line in hooks/precompact_handoff_prompt.md and the send_later / check-in guidance: a handoff or scheduled prompt names where a list lives and how to read it (page collection, roadmap query, git ref), never the list itself. Numbers like a last-seen commit stay, as they mark where to resume. Done check: the precompact prompt carries the line; a handoff written after it names the page query, not item numbers. Needs no answer. Port: yes, every repo.
